fusions.name: Flagging Dart
fusions.desc: Fires a dart that deals 4 damage and has a 25% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Rush
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 18 damage, adding its target's remaining afflictions to it and using them up. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Running With Pike
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 15 seconds. For 10 seconds, a pike hunts beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Chase Breath
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
